topic: Haibara's ghost asks why Nanami came back to sorcery, and Yuji is the answer
title: Nanami Came Back To Sorcery For One Reason: Yuji
description: Nanami quit jujutsu after Haibara died, then came back. In Shibuya, his last vision answers why. Was Yuji really the reason, or was it guilt?
comment: Did Nanami return to sorcery for Yuji, or for Haibara's memory? Pick one.

lines.text: Nanami's last moment isn't a goodbye. It's an answer to a question he'd carried for years.

shot.fallback: bleeding sorcerer in suit in a train station

lines.text: Back at Jujutsu High, Nanami had one friend in his year, Yu Haibara.

shot.fallback: two first year students in school uniforms

lines.text: Haibara died on a mission when he misjudged the strength of the curse.

shot.fallback: young sorcerer lying defeated, dark mood

lines.text: Nanami carried the body to the morgue, and then he quit being a sorcerer.

shot.fallback: man in suit walking away from a school

lines.text: He sees Haibara, who doesn't speak and just points.

shot.fallback: ghost of a friend pointing in a corridor

lines.text: The answer to why he came back is standing right there. It's Yuji.

shot.fallback: boy with pink hair arriving in a station

lines.text: People say Nanami just wanted to protect a kid. But the timing says it's more than that.

shot.fallback: sorcerer facing a stitched cursed spirit

lines.text: Mahito asks for last words, and Nanami says nothing that could put Yuji in danger.

shot.fallback: dying sorcerer speaking to a monster

lines.text: He just says Yuji's got it from here.

shot.search: Nanami tells Yuji he leaves it to him

lines.text: Haibara's death sent him away, and Yuji is what finally brought him back to the fight.
Because Nanami's last moment isn't a goodbye...

shot.fallback: bleeding sorcerer in suit in a train station
